## Review checklist
- [ ] The WHY and WHY THIS WAY sections explain real reasons, not placeholders.
- [ ] The motivating issue is linked (or an exception is explained).
- [ ] Alternatives and trade-offs are documented proportionately to the change.
- [ ] Tests and results are reported accurately.
- [ ] Security and compatibility impacts have been considered.
- [ ] No automatic merge or deployment is implied by this PR.
